meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 探索代码时会改用三种工具:先搜出相关文件和符号清单,再看单个文件的结构骨架,最后按需展开某个函数或类的完整源码,不再直接整文件读取。
howto.when: 当你要找函数、理解代码结构或高效探索代码库时触发;它会接管默认的代码探索,优先用 smart_search 等三个工具,而不是 Read、Grep、Glob。

say.text: 帮我在 src 目录里搜一下处理 shutdown 的代码
say.note: 会先返回相关文件和符号列表

say.text: 给我 worker-service.ts 的结构大纲
say.note: 会列出文件里所有函数和类

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses smart_search, smart_outline, smart_unfold to search files/symbols, outline a file, then unfold a chosen function's full source, instead of reading whole files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to find functions, understand code structure, or explore a codebase efficiently; it overrides default exploration and prefers the three smart_* tools over Read, Grep, Glob.

say_en.text: Search src for code handling shutdown
say_en.note: Returns ranked files and symbols first

say_en.text: Give me the structural outline of worker-service.ts
say_en.note: Lists all functions and classes in the file
Returns the full source of that function
